title: app_box intake state
description: The pipeline-owned state slot for intake answers (plan 10.1). The answers shape is defined by skills/app-box-intake/intake.schema.json (the engine's artefact format — the skill keeps it); this schema binds those answers into pipeline state and records where the engine wrote its emitted artefacts. Architecture §22: intake elicits; it does not generate. Every field in `answers` carries provenance (client|founder|inferred); every surface carries {id,label,tab,provenance}.

answers.description: The elicited intake answers, or null before intake has run. When non-null, conforms to skills/app-box-intake/intake.schema.json: product, audience, appMustDo, targets, existingSystems, brand, constraints, outOfScope, surfaces — each with provenance.

artefacts.description: Where the engine wrote its emitted artefacts, or null before intake has run. Both the wizard (10.5) and the headless phase write the same paths — one engine, two fronts (DW1).

brief.description: Path to docs/design/brief.md emitted by intake.py emit. Every inferred field is visibly marked in the output.

registry.description: Path to docs/design/registry.json emitted by intake.py emit. surface is null in every seed entry — intake names, it never designs.
